name: portfolio-monorepo
description: Personal professional showcase website — monorepo (SvelteKit client, Express API, shared types).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run start --workspace=server" "npm run start --workspace=client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
